name: SharedWorkspaceMembers
description: A collection of the SharedWorkspaceMember objects in the current shared workspace site.
example:
Dim swsMembers As Office.SharedWorkspaceMembers
    Set swsMembers = ActiveWorkbook.SharedWorkspace.Members
    MsgBox "There are " & swsMembers.Count & _
        " member(s) in the current shared workspace.", _
        vbInformation + vbOKOnly, _
        "Collection Information"
    Set swsMembers = Nothing

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SharedWorkspaceMembers object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SharedWorkspaceMembers object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a SharedWorkspaceMember object from the Members collection of the shared workspace. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the SharedWorkspaceMembers object. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the SharedWorkspaceMembers object. Read-only.

properties.name: ItemCountExceeded
properties.description: Gets a Boolean value that indicates whether the number of SharedWorkspaceMembers items in the collection has exceeded the 99 that can be displayed in the Shared Workspace task pane. Read-only.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Email As String, DomainName As String, DisplayName As String, [Role As Variant]) As SharedWorkspaceMember
methods.description: Adds a member to the list of members in a shared workspace site. Returns a SharedWorkspaceMember object.

parameters.name: Email
parameters.description: The new member's email address in the format user@domain.com. Raises an error if the user is not a valid candidate for membership in the shared workspace site.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The new member's Windows user name in the format domain\user.

parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description: The display name to display for the new member.

parameters.name: Role
parameters.description: An optional role that determines the tasks that the new member can accomplish in the shared workspace site; for example, "Contributor." An invalid role name raises an error.
